frozen_preregistration: Sensitivity varies reference freshness over 60/120/300 seconds.
executed_implementation: The sensitivity runner passes each freshness value through the shared relationship-input freshness parameter, so target and reference quote freshness change together.
impact: Primary RV-001 estimates use the preregistered 120-second common freshness and are unaffected. The structural-residual stability surface is not a pure reference-freshness sensitivity and must not be over-interpreted.
disposition_effect: None: RV-001 has no global-FDR rejection and remains INCONCLUSIVE independently of this stability diagnostic.
remediation: If structural residual is revisited, implement reference-only freshness sensitivity in a new experiment or explicitly preregister common target/reference freshness sensitivity.
